say:1:1826031001:1.text: Now then, there is one more matter that strikes me as rather curious...
say:1:1826031001:1.source_cn: 说起来，还有一件事，仔细想来颇为蹊跷。
say:1:1826031001:1.male: Now then, there is one more matter that strikes me as rather curious...
say:1:1826031001:1.female: Now then, there is one more matter that strikes me as rather curious...

say:2:1826031002:1.text: How did Mother end up so gravely injured?
say:2:1826031002:1.source_cn: ——母亲大人为何会突然身负重伤？

say:4:1826031003:1.text: No need to mince words with me, Magister Merlin.
say:4:1826031003:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，你我之间就不必拐弯抹角了。
say:4:1826031003:1.male: No need to mince words with me, Magister Merlin.
say:4:1826031003:1.female: No need to mince words with me, Magister Merlin.

say:5:1826031004:1.text: You and I both know that scarcely anyone could wound Mother so gravely, least of all that assassin. Otherwise, Bantus would have seized Novaris long ago.
say:5:1826031004:1.source_cn: 您和我都心知肚明，区区一个刺客，没有本事将母亲大人伤至...

say:6:1826031005:1.text: I suspect Mother was already injured before the attack, and that assassin merely took advantage of the situation.
say:6:1826031005:1.source_cn: 我想，母亲大人恐怕早已受伤，而刺客只是抓住了可乘之机。

say:11:1826031009:1.text: You didn't become undead on the spot, and Mother was merely gravely wounded... Remarkable.
say:11:1826031009:1.source_cn: 你竟然没有当场变成亡灵，母亲大人也只是受了重伤……真是...
say:11:1826031009:1.male: You didn't become undead on the spot, and Mother was merely gravely wounded... Remarkable.
say:11:1826031009:1.female: You didn't become undead on the spot, and Mother was merely gravely wounded... Remarkable.

say:12:1826031010:1.text: Once Mother wakes, I shall have her satisfy my curiosity.

say:13:1826031011:1.text: Now, it's time for you to <style="highlight">take on Mother's appearance</style>. With your mana, I doubt anyone will notice a thing.
